en: Sepia-toned photograph framed by a dark foreground archway, showing an inner courtyard with plain stucco buildings in a restrained early-20th‑century style. The main building on the right has three large arched doorways at ground level and tall arched windows above with small balconies. Additional rectangular windows line the facade. In the background is another block with simpler windows and a passageway arch. A few small human figures walk or stand in the courtyard. The image has a wide white border and a handwritten archival code along the right edge.
